expected_issues.title: Insecure Password Hashing (MD5)
expected_issues.message: MD5 is a cryptographically broken algorithm unsuitable for password hashing. It is vulnerable to brute-force and rainbow table attacks.
expected_issues.suggestion: Use bcrypt, argon2, or scrypt for password hashing.
expected_issues.resolution_example:
import bcrypt
salt = bcrypt.gensalt()
hashed = bcrypt.hashpw(password.encode(), salt)
